title: {{site.name}} · Dictation app for Mac and Linux, no subscription
description: Hold a key and talk. Your text appears where your cursor is. About 0.1 cents per dictation with OpenAI, free and private with a local model. Open source.
og_image_alt: Blink, the {{site.name}} pixel character, shows how to dictate
ld_os: macOS 14 or later (Apple silicon), Linux (Arch with Hyprland)
hero_kicker: Mac and Linux · Open source · Beta
hero_lead: Hold a key and talk. Your text appears where your cursor is, translated if you like. With OpenAI a dictation costs about 0.1 cents. With a model on your own computer it costs nothing and stays there.
hero_meta: macOS 14 with Apple silicon, notarized by Apple, no {{site.name}} account. The app's menus are in German for now.
stage_label: A small panel grows out of the Mac's notch, Blink listens, then the text is pasted into a message.
hud_oops_sub: No connection. Your recording is saved.
notes_text: I'm still on my way. Let's start half an hour later.
stage_note: The notch panel and Blink are in the Mac beta as of build 12. On Macs without a notch, the panel floats at the top of the screen.
cost_lead: No subscription. The beta is free, and the finished app will cost a few euros, once. The dictations themselves cost you this little:
cost_openai: for a 15-second dictation with your own OpenAI key.
cost_month: a month if you dictate ten minutes every day. A dictation subscription usually costs $8 to $15.
cost_local: with a local model. Available now on Mac and Linux.
cost_meta: OpenAI price for gpt-transcribe, as of October 2026. With OpenAI, translating adds a small text request per dictation.
private_lead: With a local model, your own device recognizes what you say. Neither your recording nor your text leaves it. You don't need a key or an account.
private_link: How to set it up (in German)
private_openai: With OpenAI, the recording goes straight from your device to OpenAI, with your own key. I see none of it, and the app tracks nothing. The code is open on GitHub.
route_local_note: Stays on the device. With the model from the guide, translating doesn't work yet.
route_openai_note: With your own key, without going through us. If you translate, your text goes there too.
kino1: Hold a key, talk, let go. Your text appears where your cursor is: in an email, a chat or a document.
kino3: You speak English; out comes German or one of eleven other languages. For emails abroad or gaming chat. The Mac's built-in dictation doesn't translate.
kino4: If the network drops or the service hiccups, your recording stays on your computer. Click “Nochmal senden” (Send again) to send it, any time within 24 hours.
kino2: Enter a server running on your computer. Then a dictation costs nothing, and the recording stays with you.
kino5: Download the app, drag it to Applications, enter a key or server, pick a shortcut. That's it.
kino_all: All guides with subtitles and transcripts
cta_lead: It's a beta. If something's off, write to me.
why: I dictate every day, at work and in gaming chat. I didn't want a subscription for something that costs a fraction of a cent per dictation.
guide_description: Five short videos with Blink: dictating, free with a local model, translating as you go, nothing gets lost, and first steps on the Mac.
guide_image_alt: Blink, the {{site.name}} pixel character, shows how to dictate
guide_lead: Five short videos, none longer than 17 seconds. Blink speaks German; the subtitles and the text under each video are in English.
clip1_desc: Blink shows how to dictate with {{site.name}}: hold a key, talk, let go.
clip1_say: Hey, I'm Blink. Let me show you how to dictate. Hold down your key and just start talking. Let go, and I'll write it down. Done. Your text is right where you were.
clip2_desc: Blink shows how to dictate for free with your own server on your computer.
clip2_say: Dictating doesn't have to cost a cent. Enter your own server in the settings. Then your recording stays on your computer. And with OpenAI, a dictation costs about a tenth of a cent.
clip2_link: How to set up a local model (in German)
clip3_desc: Blink shows how {{site.name}} pastes your German dictation in English right away.
clip3_say: You speak German, I write English. Pick your target language and just speak German. I'll translate it for you. And there it is in English. Perfect for gaming chat.
clip4_desc: Blink shows how to send a recording again after the network drops.
clip4_say: Network down? No drama. Oops. Your recording is still saved. As soon as it works again, click Nochmal senden (Send again). And your text is there.
clip5_desc: Blink shows how to set up {{site.name}} on the Mac in a minute.
clip5_say: You'll be ready in a minute. Download the app and drag it to Applications. Enter your key, or your own server. Pick a shortcut, and off you go.
